wheelSupport.directDrive: Untested; without HID PID force feedback the page switches to the bridge
wheelSupport.pxn: Untested; HID PID with Set Effect values of its own, which no PXN wheel has confirmed

wheelSupport.thrustmasterBridgeOnly: Untested; bridge only: the T150 and TMX take a different command set, and hid-tmff2 does not cover the T500RS
wheelSupport.fanatecCslElite: Untested; without HID PID force feedback the page switches to the bridge

frontWing.more: More front grip at speed, looser rear

rearWing.more: More stability and traction, more drag

diffOn.less: Easier on the rears, inside wheel spins

diffOff.less: Rotates on entry, can feel loose

engineBraking.more: More rear braking on lift, rotates

camberRear.less: Better traction out of slow corners

toeFront.more: Steadier on the straights, lazier turn-in

toeRear.more: Stable rear, a little more drag

bias.less: Rotates on entry, rears lock first

coldPsi.more: Warms up faster, less peak grip
coldPsi.less: More grip, slower to warm up

blankets.more: Warm tyres from the first corner
blankets.less: Cold out of the garage, warm them on the out-lap

tc.less: Faster exits, rear can step out

abs.less: Shorter stops if you are precise

bumpStopRate.more: Firmer when it hits the stops

bumpStopRange.less: Hits the stops sooner, flatter platform

preload.more: Stable in fast corners, pushes slow

bump.more: Body moves less, harsher on bumps

fastRebound.more: Wheel stays down slower after kerbs

radiator.less: Less drag, the engine runs hot

gearSet.more: Long gears: top speed on long straights
gearSet.less: Short gears: quicker out of slow corners

heaveSpring.more: Flatter platform at speed, harsher on bumps
heaveSpring.less: Rides bumps, the floor moves more

heavePacker.less: The packer holds the floor up sooner

cornerPacker.more: The stops come sooner, flatter in the corners

tcSlipAngle.more: Cuts sooner as the rear slides
tcSlipAngle.less: Lets the rear slide further on power

motorDeploy.more: More electric push, drains the battery

regen.more: More charge back, more rear braking
regen.less: Calmer rear on the brakes, less charge
